title: Moderated Activities
tagline: Bring analogue challenges into the digital journey.
shortDescription: Can throwing, strength towers, and other hands-on games join the digital journey: a moderator scans the guest, logs the result and a photo on a tablet, and the score lands on the leaderboard and in the guest's recap.
longDescription: Not every experience needs a screen. This module connects fully analogue activities, from can throwing and hammer games to jump-height or strength challenges, to the visitor journey. At each station a moderator scans the guest's QR code or NFC token, enters the result as a score, time, distance, rank, or simple pass, and can add a photo from the tablet in the same step. Results sync in real time, so physical performances appear on leaderboards, unlock the next step, and end up in personal recaps and digital souvenirs, just like any connected module. Result types, station names and branding, photo settings, and the moderator's language are configurable per station. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: No Clipboards, No Lost Results
highlights.description: Moderators use one fast tablet flow instead of paper lists, so every score is consistent, timestamped, and synced the moment it is entered.

highlights.title: Physical Wins on the Big Leaderboard
highlights.description: The best throws, jumps, and team efforts compete alongside digital scores, so the most exciting moments of the event count too.

highlights.title: A Photo at the Peak of the Challenge
highlights.description: The moderator captures the moment from the tablet and links it to the guest, turning a great throw into a personal, shareable souvenir.

highlights.title: Room for Screen-Shy Visitors
highlights.description: Guests who don't want to play on a device still join the journey through play that feels natural, while the digital layer works quietly in the background.

highlights.title: Raise the Stakes
highlights.description: Add a live record wall for each station, team relay scoring across several activities, a VIP challenge lane, progressive unlocks from station to station, or a host who calls out new records over the PA.

highlights.title: Any Challenge, Any Crowd
highlights.description: Run a carnival fairground with tin-can alley and ring toss, a Wild West day, team away-day Olympics, a sports scouting combine, or a Christmas market with snowball throws and gift-wrapping races.

highlights.title: Analogue Play, Real Numbers
highlights.description: Add a data layer that turns every station into reporting: participation and results per station, throughput and peak times, and a photo archive per guest, exportable for event reports or a CRM.

highlights.title: Every Station Connected
highlights.description: Pair with Visitor Identificator for the guest tokens, with Journey Manager to make each station a stop on the route, with Journey Recap to send results and photos afterwards, or with Crowd Games to combine physical and digital scores in one ranking.

states.trigger: The station is set up and the moderator's tablet is active, waiting for the next participant
states.experience: The tablet displays the station identity and a prompt to locate or scan the next visitor. The physical activity area is prepared and the moderator is in position.
states.feedback: Station name, activity title, and visitor lookup prompt on moderator screen
states.configurable: Station name, activity type label, branding on moderator interface

states.trigger: A visitor arrives at the activity station
states.experience: The moderator scans the visitor's QR code, taps their NFC token, or searches by name, pulling up their profile and linking the upcoming result to their record.
states.feedback: Visitor name and token confirmed on moderator screen; optional welcome or instruction displayed
states.configurable: Lookup method (scan, tap, manual search), confirmation message
states.data: Visitor token linked, arrival time at station

states.trigger: Visitor is identified and the physical activity begins
states.experience: The visitor performs the analogue challenge. The moderator observes, assists if needed, and prepares to log the result. A photo opportunity is flagged if configured.
states.feedback: Active state on moderator tablet, result entry fields ready, photo capture button available
states.configurable: Result input type (score, time, distance, rank, pass/fail), photo prompt toggle

states.trigger: The activity is complete: the moderator records the outcome
states.experience: The moderator enters the result and optionally uploads a photo. A single confirmation tap submits everything to the BRDGE backend, instantly updating the visitor's record, leaderboard, and recap.
states.feedback: Success confirmation on moderator tablet; optional real-time leaderboard update on nearby display
states.configurable: Result field labels, photo upload, confirmation message, leaderboard push toggle
states.data: Score or result logged, photo uploaded, leaderboard position updated, timestamp

states.trigger: Result is submitted and the visitor's journey record is updated
states.experience: The visitor can be shown their result, their leaderboard position, or a preview of their digital souvenir, before the station resets for the next participant.
states.feedback: Optional result display for the visitor (on tablet, nearby screen, or their own device), reset prompt for moderator
states.configurable: Visitor-facing result display, CTA (check leaderboard, view recap), reset flow
states.data: Confirmed result in visitor record, rank assigned, souvenir or recap triggered if configured
